name: J.M. Smucker Co.
summary:
J.M. Smucker (SJM) reported earnings of $2.77 per share on revenue of $2.27 billion for the fiscal fourth quarter ended April 2026. The consensus earnings estimate was $2.65 per share on revenue of $2.27 billion. The Earnings Whisper number was $2.72 per share. The company beat expectations by 1.84% while revenue grew 5.80% on a year-over-year basis.

The company said it expects fiscal 2027 earnings of $9.75 to $10.25 per share on revenue of $8.70 billion to $8.79 billion. The current consensus earnings estimate is $9.68 per share on revenue of $9.17 billion for the year ending April 30, 2027.

"Our strong fourth quarter results demonstrate the continued strength of our focused strategy and portfolio enhancement efforts, which have transformed the Company over time," said Mark Smucker, Chief Executive Officer, President and Chair of the Board. "We delivered positive net sales and earnings growth in the quarter, while navigating a dynamic external environment, and we are entering fiscal year 2027 with meaningful momentum."

JM Smucker Co manufactures and markets branded food products on a worldwide basis, although the majority of its sales are in the U.S.
subject: J.M. Smucker Beat Expectations
